title: Global menu displays wrong accelerators and cannot show menus when activating shortcut keys
line: Alt+letter shortcuts now open the Global Menu every time, and holding Alt underlines the app's real letters.
explanation: The applet's menu was created as a child of the app's imported menu, and QMenu makes its parent's window the transient parent every time it is shown, replacing the panel the applet had set. On Wayland Qt then falls back to the last window that got input, which after the first use is the already destroyed menu popup, so it refuses the popup ("Failed to create grabbing popup") and Alt+F does nothing. The underlines came from Kirigami's mnemonic assignment, whose letter table is shared by the whole process: every model reset recreates the buttons while the old ones still hold Alt+F, Alt+E… until they are deleted, so the new buttons get second-choice letters (F_i_le, E_d_it, Vie_w_). The menu is now created without a parent widget (and still deleted with the app's menu), so the panel stays its transient parent; the buttons underline the letter the app itself marks with &, since the app is what handles Alt+letter.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: fix keyboard shortcuts and their underlines

Parenting the menu made QMenu replace the panel as its transient parent,
so Alt+letter only opened it once, and Kirigami gave letters still held
by deleted buttons; now we keep the panel and underline the app's own.

BUG: 512473

media.caption: Master: Dolphin focused, Alt+F pressed a second time after Esc: no menu opens (log: Failed to create grabbing popup)
With the fix: the second Alt+F opens Dolphin's File menu from the Global Menu
Master, mnemonics shown: wrong letters underlined (F_i_le, E_d_it, Vie_w_, Too_l_s, Setti_n_gs, Hel_p_)
With the fix: the app's own letters underlined (File, Edit, View, Go, Tools, Settings, Help)
